family: R10-N neutral: alpha-decay extension tren tin hieu frozen majority_1x (tiep noi N-decay v37)
hypothesis: Neu edge majority_1x la alpha that voi horizon dai thi Ret/Mo van duong tai d12/d24; neu chet dan thi tim delay nao Ret<0 / PF<1 / fills<30 (dinh nghia edge chet). D12=1h, d24=2h, d48=4h tren nen 5m.
scenario_cells_note: 4 normal (d1/d12/d24/d48) + 2 fee_stress (d12,d48 x fee 0.00055) = 6 scenario-cells. Khong chay execution_stress o round nay de giu chi phi thap. dd_guard cho delay-48 normal la TUY CHON (khong pre-spec, chi chay follow-up neu re va luu rieng, khong nhap vao 6 cells).
control: majority_d1 (entry_delay=1 tren majority_1x) normal phai khop published majority_1x (+165.17829563633% total_return 1.6517829563633004, -20.09% max_drawdown -0.20086073993367803, 63 trades) trong 1e-9 hoac STOP
entry_window: Control (delay=1): first_entry_bar = signal_index + 1, last_entry_bar = min(signal_index + entry_expiry_bars, len-1) — verbatim engine ohlc-v2. Delay (delay=k): first_entry_bar = signal_index + k, last_entry_bar = min(signal_index + entry_expiry_bars + k - 1, len-1) — giu nguyen do dai expiry (12 bars), holding_bars tinh tu entry thuc te nhu engine. Tai su dung truc tiep run_latency_backtest tu scripts/opencode_r8n_latency.py (khong copy-paste logic), chi tham so hoa entry_delay. Fee_stress: cung runner voi fee_rate_per_fill=0.00055.
monthly_formula: ratio=final_equity/100; duration_years=(complete_evaluation_until - folds[0][0])/(365.2425*86400) theo configs/swing_v15_continuous_folds.json (giong v15/v30/v33/v37); monthly_geometric_net=ratio^(1/(12*duration_years))-1; annual=ratio^(1/duration_years)-1.
engine_note: Toan bo backtest con lai (stop/timeout market-like o scenario fee, TP1 50% + TP2, funding long 0.0001/8h short 0, stop-first intrabar, TP suppression tren intrabar entry candle, drawdown trade-candle-close sampled, compounding tu equity hien tai, overlap next_available_index, holding validation) GIU NGUYEN nhu engine ohlc-v2 qua driver v33. Chi cua so entry-search dich theo delay.

edge_death.note: Edge chet tai delay k neu bat ky: Ret<0 HOAC PF<1 HOAC fills<30 (danh gia tren normal; PF null khi khong co loss duoc coi la khong-chet theo tieu chi PF).

verdict_note: Day la thang alpha-decay horizon mo rong (d12/d24/d48 = 1h/2h/4h), KHONG phai gate loi nhuan. Khong claim maker fill probability/queue tu OHLC; delay la gia dinh stress chu quan.
